<content>
1: // Simple endless runner game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship moves upward on click/tap, gravity pulls down, asteroids appear randomly.
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Background music (placeholder silent track)
11:   const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA');
12:   bgMusic.loop = true;
13:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
14:   bgMusic.play();
15: 
16:   // Audio context for generated tones
17:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
18:   function playTone(freq, dur){
19:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
20:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
21:     gain.gain.value = 0.1;
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     osc.type = 'square';
24:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
25:     osc.start();
26:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
27:   }
28:   function playCrash(){
29:     // quick descending tone for crash
30:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
31:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
32:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
33:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
34:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
36:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
37:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     osc.start();
39:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
40:   }
41: 
42:   // Game objects
43:   const ship = { x: 80, y: H/2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0 };
44:   const asteroids = [];
45:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
46:   const stars = [];
47:   for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
48:     stars.push({x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H, r: Math.random()*2});
49:   }
50: 
51:   let lastTime = 0;
52:   let gameOver = false;
53: 
54:   // Input – click/tap adds upward thrust and plays sound
55:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',()=>{ ship.vy=-0.6; playTone(400,0.08); });
56:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',()=>{ ship.vy=-0.6; playTone(400,0.08); });
57: 
58:   function spawnAsteroid(){
59:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
60:     asteroids.push({x:W+size, y:Math.random()*(H-size), w:size, h:size, vx:-2-Math.random()*2});
61:   }
62: 
63:   function update(dt){
64:     if(gameOver) return;
65:     // gravity
66:     ship.vy += 0.0015*dt; // gentle pull down
67:     ship.y += ship.vy*dt*0.06; // scale speed
68:     // bounds check (bottom ends game)
69:     if(ship.y > H - ship.h){
70:       gameOver = true;
71:       crashSound.play();
72:     }
73:     // move asteroids
74:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
75:       const a = asteroids[i];
76:       a.x += a.vx*dt*0.06;
77:       if(a.x + a.w < 0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
78:     }
79:     // spawn periodically
80:     if(Math.random()<0.02) spawnAsteroid();
81:     // collision detection
82:     for(const a of asteroids){
83:       if(ship.x < a.x + a.w && ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
84:          ship.y < a.y + a.h && ship.y + ship.h > a.h){
85:         gameOver = true;
86:         crashSound.play();
87:         break;
88:       }
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function draw(){
93:     // gradient background (dark to deep blue)
94:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
95:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00102a');
96:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
97:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
98:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
99: 
100:     // twinkling stars (vary opacity & size)
101:     for(const s of stars){
102:       const twinkle = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.random();
103:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${twinkle})`;
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
106:       ctx.fill();
107:     }
108: 
109:     // ship with thrust flame when moving up
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
111:     ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
113:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
114:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h/2);
115:     ctx.closePath();
116:     ctx.fill();
117:     // flame effect
118:     if(ship.vy < -0.2){
119:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
122:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h/2 + 5);
123:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2 + 10);
124:       ctx.closePath();
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     }
127: 
128:     // asteroids with radial shading
129:     for(const a of asteroids){
130:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
131:         a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w*0.1,
132:         a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2
133:       );
134:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
135:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
136:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2,0,Math.PI*2);
139:       ctx.fill();
140:     }
141: 
142:     // game over overlay
143:     if(gameOver){
144:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
145:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
146:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
147:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
148:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
149:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
150:     }
151:   }
152: 
153:   function loop(timestamp){
154:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
155:     lastTime = timestamp;
156:     if(!gameOver) update(dt);
157:     draw();
158:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
159:   }
160:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
161: })();

(End of file - total 161 lines)
</content>
